ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Moves five already-pinned actions to newer releases (checkout v7.0.1, setup-node v7.1.0, upload-artifact v7.0.2, create-or-update-comment v5.0.0, lcov-reporter-action v0.4.0). Each stays pinned to a full commit SHA, independently resolved from its release tag, with a version comment, per the pin-everything convention of iterate-2026-10-23-sec-ci-hardening. Permissions, triggers and steps are unchanged.
